name: Iceberg Wedge Salad
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Animator's Palate / Triton's / Lumiere's
whyItWorks: Raw iceberg lettuce leaves, tomato skins/seeds, and heavy blue cheese dressing combine insoluble roughage with high dairy fat that can scrape and speed up an inflamed gut.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Avoid during flares. In solid remission, eat only the tender inner heart leaves, skip raw tomato skins and red onions, and swap heavy blue cheese dressing for a light drizzle of olive oil or lactose-free ranch.
flareEmergencySwap: Swap the salad course for a smooth blended soup (like Baked Potato Soup or Creamy Butternut Squash Soup) or warm bread rolls.
